module: Flowgraph node "Set Camera Mode" (repeat_instant, depends on core_camera). Input pin: mode (string), name of the camera mode. On each execution, if the name is not empty, calls core_camera.setByName(0, mode).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

work.desc: Changes the camera mode of player 0 via core_camera.setByName if the mode pin is not empty.
